"''That depends on how you answer what I'm about to ask.|The Pyke and Boba Fett|}} A [[Gender|male]] [[Pyke]] '''traveler''' ran the [[transport]]ation of [[sansanna spice]] on a [[Pyke Syndicate]] [[Tatooine repulsor train|repulsor train]] at the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Traveling through the [[Dune Sea]], the Pykes [[Skirmish in the Dune Sea|conflicted]] with a [[Tusken Raider]] tribe, prompting the Tuskens to launch a counterattack. The [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|attack]] was successful and the [[hovertrain]] was crashed, the traveler and his surviving comrades being captured. [[Boba Fett]], a [[bounty hunter]] living with the tribe, confronted the traveler and gave new terms to pass on to the syndicate before making the Pykes walk across the [[Dune Sea]] for the settlement [[Anchorhead]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|No harm will come of you.''"
"''We will die of thirst without our water car.''"
"''We will give you each a black melon. You will survive on its milk as these people do.|Fett advises the Pykes to travel across the Dune Sea|}} In [[5 ABY]],{{InsiderCite|225|A Certain Point of View (department)}} states that flashback events of "[[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine]]" took place five [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], corresponding to [[5 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. the [[Gender|male]] [[Pyke]] worked for the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He ran the [[transport]]ation of [[sansanna spice]] aboard a [[Tatooine repulsor train|repulsor train]] which traveled across Tatooine's [[Dune Sea]]. The [[hovertrain]]'s presence came in conflict with the local [[Tusken Raider]]s, who laid ancestral claim upon the Dune Sea, and [[Pyke Syndicate Foot Soldier|Pyke guards]] [[Skirmish in the Dune Sea|open fired]] on one such tribe as they passed. However, the tribe began preparing for a counterattack with the help of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]]. The tribe [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|ambushed]] the Pyke train when it passed, grounding the hover vehicle and [[Death|killing]] many defending Pykes. [[File:Boba-Pyke-captives.png|thumb|left|300px|The Pyke traveler speaks to Boba Fett]] The Pyke traveler was among those Pykes who survived the attack, and he and his people were rounded up by the Tusken tribe. Sitting before the group, Fett asked who the leader was. The traveler, looking at his peers, walked up to the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] and removed his [[helmet]], wondering if the tribe was going to kill them. Looking for his own answers, Fett asked if the train was carrying [[spice]], the Pyke pretending that he didn't know what the bounty hunter meant until two Tuskens brought out a crate of sansanna spice. The traveler instead insisted that his people were only trying to protect their route. Fett set out new terms for the Pykes: they could only pass through the Dune Sea if they paid a toll and any deaths caused by them would be returned ten-fold. Telling the traveler to pass on the terms to his syndicate, the bounty hunter ordered the Pyke prisoners to walk in a single file in the direction of the higher of the two [[Star|suns]], which could lead them to the settlement [[Anchorhead]]. The Pyke traveler believed his people would be killed on the journey, but Fett assured them they were under the protection of the Tusken Raiders. Although the traveler still worried about thirst, the bounty hunter promised a [[black melon]] for each of the Pykes as its [[milk]] could keep them hydrated. Fett thus advised the Pykes to leave, and the group begun traveling. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|We thought you were uncivilized raiders. We were trying to protect our route.|The traveler trying to justify killing Tusken Raiders|}} A Pyke male, the traveler had skin which faced from light blue to beige from top to bottom of his head. He attempted to hide the motivations of his people, acting like he did not know what spice was and implying that the Tusken Raiders were the aggressors. When Fett left the Pykes with a journey across the Dunes, traveler showed doubt that his group would make it without protection and hydration, prompting further favors from the bounty hunter. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Are you carrying spice?''"
"''What do you mean by "spice"?''"
"''Sansanna spice from the slave mines of Kessel.|Fett and the traveler|}} The traveler wore black and yellow robes with black [[glove]]s, black boots and a black helmet with an orange metal faceshield. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|To answer those wondering who I gave voice to in #TheBookOfBobaFett: It was the Pyke Leader from the train. Wouldn't want to be in his shoes when he reports back to Marg Krim & The Syndicate!|Stephen Stanton on Twitter|}} The Pyke traveler appeared in the flashbacks of "[[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine]]," the second episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was directed by [[Steph Green]] and released on [[January 5]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} Credited as "Pyke Traveler," the character was portrayed by [[Alfred Hsing]]. While not credited in the episode itself, [[Stephen Stanton]] provided the character's voice, revealing his role on Twitter.{{Twitter|Stephen_Stanton|status/1479927697014804481|[[Stephen Stanton]]|quote=To answer those wondering who I gave voice to in #TheBookOfBobaFett: It was the Pyke Leader from the train.
